Application Deadlines
For all dates listed, the deadline is 11:59:59 p.m., Eastern Standard Time.
If there is a discrepancy between the deadline information on this page and other materials you may have received, you should adhere to the deadlines on this page.

1 Applied Ethics & Policy applicants: All applications received by January 21, 2027 will receive a final decision by February 28, 2027. Applications received by March 18, 2027 are guaranteed review. After March 18, 2027, applications will be accepted on a space-available basis through May 31, 2027.
2 Biomedical Engineering master's applicants: Applications submitted by November 3 are guaranteed the earliest review and decision. Applications submitted by February 1, 2027 are guaranteed review on a space-available basis.
3 Civil & Environmental Engineering master's applicants:Applications submitted by January 10, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications submitted after the January 10, 2027 deadline will be reviewed on a space-available basis through February 25, 2027.
4 Dance MFA applicants: Late applications will be considered under special circumstances. Applicants are advised to contact Prof. Sarah Wilbur (sarah.wilbur@duke.edu) before starting an application.
5 East Asian Studies applicants: All applications received by January 31, 2027 are guaranteed review and will be considered for departmental funding. Applications received after the priority deadline will be accepted for review on a space-available basis through April 22, 2027.
6 Electrical and Computer Engineering master's applicants: Applications submitted by January 16, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications submitted after the January 16, 2027 deadline will be reviewed on a space-available basis through February 25, 2027.
7 Global Health applicants: The priority deadline is January 08, 2027, though all applications received by February 26, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications received after February 26, 2027 will be reviewed on a space-available basis through June 1, 2027.
8 Graduate Liberal Studies applicants: All applications submitted by June 01, 2027 are guaranteed review; however, applicants submitting materials by February 15, 2027 will receive an admissions decision by March 15, 2027 and will have priority consideration for financial aid.
9 Master of Arts in Teaching applicants: The priority deadline is January 29, 2027, though all applications received by February 19, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications received after February 19, 2027 will be reviewed on a space-available basis through April 30, 2027.
10 Materials Science and Engineering applicants: Applications submitted by November 3 are guaranteed the earliest review and decision. The priority deadline is January 31, 2027. All applications received by March 15, 2027 are guaranteed review.
11 Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science master's applicants: Applications submitted by January 19, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications submitted after the January 19, 2027 deadline will be reviewed on a space-available basis through March 17, 2027.
12 Medical Physics applicants: The priority deadline is January 08, 2027, though all applications received by January 31, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications received after February 01, 2027 will be reviewed on a space-available basis through June 1, 2027.
13 Population Health Sciences applicants: The early application deadline is December 1, 2026. All applications received by December 1 will receive an admissions decision by January 2027. The priority deadline is January 15, 2027, though all applications received by February 26, 2027 are guaranteed review. Applications received after February 26, 2027 will be reviewed on a space-available basis through June 1, 2027.
Spring Semester
Ph.D. and Master's Deadlines
October 1: Deadline to submit all Ph.D. and master’s applications (except Graduate Liberal Studies) for the spring semester, space permitting.
November 2: Deadline to submit Graduate Liberal Studies master's applications for the spring semester.

Summer session
Very few departments accept new students for the summer session. With the exception of applicants to the Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT) program (which begins in the summer), applicants who wish to apply for summer admission must obtain special permission from the department of interest and The Graduate School. Summer session applicants should adhere to the fall application deadlines.
If you missed the deadline
Once a program's deadline has passed, that program will no longer appear as an option on the application. Most programs will not consider any applications submitted after the deadline. Please contact the department directly to inquire about a late application submission.
